business_summary: NEW ART HOLDINGS Co., Ltd. operates bridal jewelry business in Japan and South Korea. The company offers bridal and fashion jewelry; artworks; and planning and operation of art auctions. It operates esthetic salons; manufactures and sales cosmetics and health food products; food processing; resort development; art dealer; and develops and sells sporting goods. In addition, the company offers engagement rings and wedding rings under the Ginza Diamond Shiraishi and Excelco Diamond brands in Japan, Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Singapore. The company was formerly known as New Art Co., Ltd. and changed its name to NEW ART HOLDINGS Co., Ltd. in October 2018. NEW ART HOLDINGS Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1966 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
